records.context: PERISCOPE (cpg0021, CP186A/B) publishes its corrected painting extracted image regions (``CorrDNA`` and the other painting image data channels) in the painting frame, but its own Cells and Nuclei masks are in the sequencing (SBS) frame. Its 04Align module records the shift between the two frames per site (``Align_Yshift_DAPI_Painting`` and ``Align_Xshift_DAPI_Painting`` in the site's ``Image.csv``; 3-77 px on CP186A Well 1). Painting features measured through those masks without that shift read the wrong pixels.
records.label: spacr.cpg_measure#1
records.source: PERISCOPE (cpg0021, CP186A/B) publishes its corrected painting crops (``CorrDNA`` and the other painting channels) in the painting frame, but its own Cells and Nuclei masks are in the sequencing (SBS) frame. Its 04Align module records the shift between the two frames per site (``Align_Yshift_DAPI_Painting`` and ``Align_Xshift_DAPI_Painting`` in the site's ``Image.csv``; 3-77 px on CP186A Well 1). Painting features measured through those masks without that shift read the wrong pixels.
records.translation: PERISCOPE (cpg0021, CP186A/B)는 보정된 페인팅 크롭 이미지(``CorrDNA`` 및 다른 페인팅 채널)를 페인팅 좌표계로 공개하지만, 자체 Cells 및 Nuclei 마스크는 시퀀싱(SBS) 좌표계에 있습니다. 04Align 모듈은 각 사이트에서 두 좌표계 사이의 이동량을 기록합니다(``Align_Yshift_DAPI_Painting`` 및 ``Align_Xshift_DAPI_Painting``, 사이트의 ``Image.csv`` 에 저장; 3-77 px, CP186A Well 1 에서). 이 이동을 적용하지 않고 해당 마스크로 페인팅 특징을 측정하면 잘못된 픽셀을 읽게 됩니다.

No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.context: The ``cpg_measure`` phase reads each site's painting image layers, moves every image layer into the mask frame by the site's shift (``cpg_painting_frame_shift``), measures it with :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field`, flags the cells that touch the zero-filled band the shift leaves at the microscope field of view border (``painting_shift_border``) and records every applied shift in ``painting_frame_shift_<plate>_<well>.csv``.
records.label: spacr.cpg_measure#2
records.source: The ``cpg_measure`` phase reads each site's painting planes, moves every plane into the mask frame by the site's shift (``cpg_painting_frame_shift``), measures it with :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field`, flags the cells that touch the zero-filled band the shift leaves at the field border (``painting_shift_border``) and records every applied shift in ``painting_frame_shift_<plate>_<well>.csv``.
records.translation: ``cpg_measure`` 단계는 각 사이트의 페인팅 이미지 평면을 읽고, 사이트의 이동량(``cpg_painting_frame_shift``)에 따라 모든 평면을 마스크 좌표계로 옮긴 후 :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field` 로 측정합니다. 이동으로 인해 시야 가장자리에 생긴 영으로 채운 띠에 닿는 세포를 표시하고(``painting_shift_border``), 적용한 모든 이동량을 ``painting_frame_shift_<plate>_<well>.csv`` 에 기록합니다.
